pageCache.text:
A Very Warm Welcome to Rotherfield Primary School, Crowborough, East Sussex
Rotherfield Primary School, East Sussex is a friendly, caring school with high expectations for all our pupils. Our children are encouraged to explore, discover and question through a range of exciting learning opportunities both inside and outside the classroom.
Our staff work hard to provide a safe, calm and stimulating environment where good behaviour and mutual respect is modelled by everyone and where everyone is valued.

Important Dates for 26-27 Cohort

Rotherfield Primary School is a one form entry school (equating to 30 places). Children join Peake (Reception Class) the September before their fifth birthday. Rotherfield Football Team represent North Wealden at the Sussex U11
On Wednesday 20th January our fabulous football team, travelled to Lancing to represent North Wealden in the Sussex U11 7 aside Pokémon Primary finals. With the support of all their parents, the boys played some fantastic football, so much so that they did not lose a single game ! This meant that they reached the final of the group games where they just missed out on going through to the next round. What an awesome achievement from the boys - Edward, Oli, Luke, Rupert, Archie, George, Josh and Ethan, you should be so proud of yourselves ! This is the furthest and most successful that Rotherfield Primary has ever done in this competition and I am so grateful that I have had the privilege to be part of this with you all. My thanks go to Ben as the team coach, he hasn't missed a beat and has always encouraged the boys to do their best, not just to play great football but also to have superb sportsmanship, which they all showed on Wednesday and of course to all the parents, for showing up, standing in the cold cheering and supporting the boys. Thank you all and well done !

SEND Information
Special Educational Need and Disability
Every child at some point in their school life requires extra support, care and attention. Each situation requires special attention, with the class teacher initially analysing and assessing the pupil, assisted by the Inclusion Manager if necessary.
An intervention programme of learning or behaviour activities related to those additional needs is drawn up and put into action in either the classroom setting or in the school as a whole, i.e. the playground.
If the child’s needs cannot be met within the school’s own resources, the Inclusion Manager will involve outside agencies for support and advice, such as Educational Psychologist, Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist, Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services. In all aspects of Special Needs our partnership with parents, for the good of all our pupils, plays a crucial role. We encourage parents to contact their child’s teacher if they have any concerns about their child.
The school also aims to recognise all children’s gifts and talents, our able pupils are recognised as having special educational needs. In the areas of the curriculum where they demonstrate a high level of ability they will be recognised and given the opportunity to take part in a programme to support their learning/enjoyment in that area to further meet their individual needs.
Miss Robins is our SENCO. To contact her, please email inclusion@rotherfield-cps.e-sussex.sch.uk

Welcome
I am immensely proud to welcome you to Rotherfield Primary School, East Sussex. I hope that our website will give you a sense of what a warm and welcoming school we are.
Rotherfield Primary School’s strengths lie in its caring and nurturing environment, dedicated staff and governors, and above all the determination of our pupils to succeed.
Rotherfield Primary School is a one form entry school, and we have capacity for 210 children across 7 classes. The children are allocated one of our four house teams upon admission for intra school events and competitions.
We are a friendly, caring school with high expectations for all our pupils. Our children are encouraged to explore, discover and question through a range of exciting learning opportunities both inside and outside the classroom. We have access to a Forest School area and children get the opportunity to visit it regularly. Our staff work hard to provide a safe, calm and stimulating environment where good behaviour and mutual respect is modelled by everyone and where everyone is valued.
We encourage teachers to take learning outside the classroom and make good use of the surrounding countryside. Each class also participates in a number of trips to enhance their learning; these trips vary from historical, natural and industrial locations. Our Year 6 children spend a week in away together at a residential activity centre where they are encouraged to work together, learn new skills and challenge themselves away from home, supported by several school staff.
We see our pupils’ time at Rotherfield Primary School as the educational foundation of their lifelong learning journey, and we want them to leave us as confident and enthusiastic learners. We also want our pupils to remember their time at Rotherfield with great fondness, with memories of life enriching experiences and enduring relationships.
Please do contact the office on 01892 852574 or email office@rotherfield-cps.e-sussex.sch.uk to arrange an appointment to come and view our wonderful school.
Thank you for visiting, I hope that we shall see you soon.
Kate BishopHeadteacher
